description: UI form-to-worker routing cases. Captured native values are regression anchors, not independent economic benchmarks. All market numbers are test inputs, not live quotes.
marketConstruction: Shared market copies the canonical discount, forward, price, hazard, inflation, vol-index and surface shapes. Explicit registry test quotes cover the canonical examples; base is 2023-12-28, discount factors are [0,1], [1,0.97], [40,0.3], rates/volatilities/FX and fixing inputs are stored literally. Instrument-specific production fixtures retain their market and as-of. No pricing formula is implemented here.
